note: State and covariance after each image frame, driven so no feature ever matches and the update step cannot fire. The update's scalar fallback and out-of-order handling are NOT recorded here: P4.4 requires changing both, so a parity fixture would bless them. See docs/migration/VIO_CONTRACT.md.

cases.name: no_imu_constant_velocity
cases.note: no IMU at all, so each frame takes the single constant-velocity step

cases.name: stationary_gravity_cancelled
cases.note: accelerometer reads +g, so world acceleration is zero and nothing moves

cases.name: constant_turn
cases.note: steady yaw rate with a forward specific force; exercises the rotation propagation

cases.name: irregular_and_boundary_imu
cases.note: uneven intervals, a sample exactly on a frame timestamp, and one past it

cases.name: imu_gap
cases.note: IMU covers the first frame only; later frames fall back to constant velocity

cases.name: repeated_frame_timestamp
cases.note: the same frame time twice; dt_total is zero, which the < 0 guard does not reject

cases.name: imu_exactly_on_previous_frame_time
cases.note: a sample at exactly the prior frame time, which the <= guard must skip
